data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Addarah' meaning 'the one who is gentle, kind, and beloved'. It is also a type of flower known as Jasmine. The name Addar carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Addar usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Addar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Al-Bakri in his 'Al-Maslik Wal-Mamalik' around 1068 AD refers to Addar as a sub-tribe of the Banu Ifran, and they were known for their bravery and warrior skills.
